title: クレーンゲーム大成功！

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Wow! That was incredible! You were like a claw machine master!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I can't believe how many plushies you managed to get! Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: If I had this many when I was little, maybe I wouldn't have been so stingy with Brian about them.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Really? I'm not so sure about us having matching plushies at our age…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But then again, it might be kind of fun. Hehe, I'll mention it the next time I see her.
